title: Clean up minor SRD spell and item modeling defects from audit
description:
Combined low-priority cleanup from the 2026-06-30 SRD audit round.

Known minor modeling issues:
- Enlarge/Reduce currently represents weapon-damage modifiers as mechanics.damage entries with fake damage types "extra" and "less". These are not real SRD damage types and should not appear in a field that deterministic damage tools interpret as dealt damage.
- Potion of healing appears as equipment:potion-of-healing with display name "Potion of healing" and magic-item:potion-of-healing with display name "Potion of Healing". The duplicate across kinds is defensible, but display capitalization should be normalized if the importer can do so without losing source fidelity.
- Add validation that spell mechanics.damage[].type only contains canonical SRD damage types unless the schema is explicitly expanded for non-damage deltas.

Acceptance criteria:
- Remodel Enlarge/Reduce as a typed weapon-damage delta/effect rather than fake direct damage types.
- Validate that mechanics.damage damage types are canonical damage types.
- Normalize Potion of Healing display name consistently across equipment and magic-item records, or document why source fidelity requires keeping the mismatch.
- Add regression tests.
close_reason: Remodeled Enlarge/Reduce's fake 'extra'/'less' damage types as typed mechanics.weaponDamageModifiers; validated mechanics.damage[].type against the 13 canonical SRD damage types; documented Potion of Healing's intentional per-kind capitalization (each spelling is source-accurate for its own physical location).
